Animal Donation Financial Summary
Fictional test document — all amounts are illustrative
Organization: Happy Tails Animal Rescue
Period: 1 April – 30 September 2027
Donation income
Individual donations: ■4,80,000
Institutional donations: ■2,20,000
Total donation income: ■7,00,000
Program expenditure
Animal food: ■2,10,000
Veterinary care and medicines: ■1,65,000
Vaccination and sterilization: ■95,000
Rescue transport: ■40,000
Shelter hygiene supplies: ■30,000
Total listed expenditure: ■5,40,000
Unspent balance from listed income: ■1,60,000
The figures are synthetic and do not represent actual financial statements. The unspent balance is a
simple difference between the illustrative income and listed expenditure; it is not a bank balance or
audited figure.
